description: We are a team of students from Yuriy Fedkovych Chernivtsi National University participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. As part of the “Field Shifts: Adapting Farms with NASA Data” challenge, we use NASA Earth observation data to develop practical tools that help farmers adapt to climate change. By combining software development, data analysis, and visualization, we aim to transform complex satellite data into clear, actionable insights for the agricultural sector.
